heading: **24 January 2026**
body:
*Protein Induction*

123.24 g in 500 mL of water → 1 M MgSO4.7H2O

*DpnI & MboI treatment for HTFS samples*

- 100 bp ladder  
- N40 non-digested  
- N40 DpnI  
- N40 MboI  
- 147 DpnI  
- 147 non-digested  
- 147 MboI

*Reconstitution Buffers*

Low salt RB (2 L)

37.28 g KCl  
20 mL 1 M Tris-HCl, pH 7.5  
4 mL 0.5 M EDTA  
2 mL DTT

Resuspend 1.54 g of DTT in 10 mL of water to prepare a 1 M stock if needed.

High salt RB (2 L)

298.2 g KCl  
20 mL 1 M Tris-HCl, pH 7.5  
4 mL 0.5 M EDTA  
2 mL DTT

*PNK treatment of N40 and 147 HTFS*

| DNA | 5 ug |
| :---- | :---- |
| T4 PNK Reaction Buffer (10X) | 5 µl |
| ATP (10 mM) | 50 pmol of \[γ-32P\] ATP |
| [T4 PNK](https://www.neb.com/en-gb/products/m0201-t4-polynucleotide-kinase) | 2 µl (20 units) |
| Nuclease-free Water | up to 50 µl  |

Incubate 37 C, 45 mins. Deactivate 65 C, 20 mins. Purify these products through a column.
